description: This Java class 'TestSupportFactory' provides utility methods for creating and setting up test data objects such as Product, Category, Country, Currency, Language, MerchantStore, ProductType, and Manufacturer. It is intended to facilitate unit testing and integration testing within the SalesManager project by supplying methods to generate complex test objects with randomized data.

classes.name: TestSupportFactory
classes.description: A utility class to generate test data objects for unit and integration testing in the SalesManager project.

methods.name: createAndStoreRandomProduct
methods.description: Creates a new Product with randomized attributes, associates it with provided manufacturer, category, store, and language, and persists it along with related availability and price data.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new Category with randomized description, optionally setting parent category, and associates it with a store and languages.

methods.name: createCountry
methods.description: Creates a new Country object with descriptions, suitable for testing country-related features.

methods.name: createCurrency
methods.description: Creates a Currency object instance linked to Canada locale, marked as supported.

methods.name: createLanguage
methods.description: Creates a Language object with specified code.

methods.name: createMerchantStore
methods.description: Creates a MerchantStore object with specified name, country, currency, and language, ready for testing.

methods.name: createProductType
methods.description: Creates a ProductType object with code indicating general type.

methods.name: createRandomManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a Manufacturer with randomized name and description for testing.

methods.name: getRandomString
methods.description: Utility method for selecting a random string from an array.
